title: Seeing Circles, Sines, and Signals: A Compact Primer on Digital Signal Processing
where: Jack Schaedler publishes the complete interactive primer at https://jackschaedler.github.io/circles-sines-signals/. Its linked public source repository is https://github.com/jackschaedler/circles-sines-signals; the repository README identifies the work as distributed under the Eclipse Public License 1.0.

shards.range: Complete interactive primer, Parts 1–5 and lessons 1–29
shards.note: A single sequential visual curriculum from signals, sound, sine waves, and sampling through transform notation, the mechanics of the DFT, and practical interpretation topics including resolution, zero-padding, leakage, and FFT libraries. Part dividers, interactive D3 visualizations, animations, equations, and audio demonstrations remain with their surrounding lessons.

notes: The live GitHub Pages corpus was verified against its own menu.js navigation. All 33 unique linked HTML pages load: 29 lesson pages plus four standalone part-divider pages (the Part 1 header and Introduction share index.html). The navigation order above follows the live menu exactly; section numbers are added only to make the 29-lesson sequence explicit. The pages contain readable explanatory text and openly served D3/MathJax-based interactive diagrams, animations, equations, and sound examples. The introduction describes the work as an intentionally compact, visual, non-rigorous companion rather than a sole DSP reference. Because the entire corpus is one short, tightly linked progression with next-page navigation, it is kept as one shard. Full access reflects public reading of the live site and public source availability; the repository README states Eclipse Public License 1.0.
